title: Bắt đầu ở đâu?
summary: Ask "Where do we start?" with Bắt đầu ở đâu?, then use the notes below to understand likely replies and next steps.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: For travelers, Bắt đầu ở đâu? is the phrase to keep ready for "Where do we start" in tickets, tours, photos, closing times, and meeting points. This is for tours, activity desks, or museum entrances. This helps when the entrance area is not obvious. It works best when you focus on turning the problem into something the other person can point to, type, or mark on a map. After you say it, listen for a point, short direction, nearby option, or counter name; the next rows help you keep the exchange moving.

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: This pattern asks where a place or service is. Swap the first part to ask about another nearby stop.

sections.title: The standard way
sections.body: Start with Bắt đầu ở đâu? for "Where do we start" when you need the listener to catch the point quickly. This is for tours, activity desks, or museum entrances. Pause after the phrase so the other person can answer with a point, short direction, nearby option, or counter name. Show the booking, ticket, room number, or time on your phone when the exact detail matters.

sections.title: Why it matters
sections.body: Sightseeing phrases help staff answer with a point, ticket, time, or location. For "Where do we start", the useful move is turning the problem into something the other person can point to, type, or mark on a map. If the answer is longer than a point or a place name, ask them to show it on your phone.

sections.title: Traveler insight
sections.body: In Sightseeing & Activities, locals often answer with a point, short direction, nearby option, or counter name rather than a long explanation. That makes Bắt đầu ở đâu? strongest when you say it once, pause, and let the other person show the next step. Show the booking, ticket, room number, or time on your phone when the exact detail matters.
